response.sql: WITH ratios AS (SELECT CASE WHEN l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT != 0 AND l.CPK IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(l.CPK AS FLOAT) / CAST(l.GPT AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END AS ratio, p.SEX FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX), filtered_sexes AS (SELECT SEX, avg_ratio FROM sex_averages WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM sex_averages)), filtered_tests AS (SELECT r.ratio FROM ratios r JOIN filtered_sexes fs ON r.SEX = fs.SEX WHERE r.ratio IS NOT NULL AND r.ratio > fs.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(ft.ratio), AVG(ft.ratio) - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM sex_averages), AVG(ft.ratio) - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM filtered_sexes) FROM filtered_tests ft
